description: Court Proceedings: Voters and the DMK candidate filed election petitions challenging the Perambur result, alleging non-disclosure of assets in the nomination; the CM sought dismissal at the threshold. Hearing date not stated in the fetched report.

Pre-poll reports include a DMK complaint to the Election Commission about a TVK candidate's video.

entity_name: DMK protest in Thanjavur on farm issues, Cauvery and Mekedatu (announced 30 Jul; held 3 Aug 2026)
description: Public Protest: DMK announced (30 Jul) and held (3 Aug) a protest in Thanjavur led by Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin against the TVK government over crop-loan waiver, Mekedatu dam, Kuruvai relief and the delay in an all-party meeting. The 3 Aug speech led to EV-0003.

entity_name: Assembly resolution seeking cancellation of NEET (11 Aug 2026)

description: Legislative Proceedings: On 7 Sep the CM made allegations about DMK-era conduct in his reply and DMK members walked out; on 8 Sep, the last day of the session, DMK members sat in demanding expunction of his remarks and were evicted on the Speaker's order.

entity_name: CM Vijay's reply to debate on Governor's address; DMK walkout (June 2026, date not captured)

Joseph Vijay from Porur Bypass, visited IIT Madras Brain Centre and dedicated projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore.
